headline: At least 27 killed in Kyiv as Russia launches massive overnight strikes
summary: A day of mourning is observed in the capital after the deadliest Russian attack on Kyiv this year, while strikes in other regions leave more dead and injured.
details: At least 27 people were killed in Kyiv on Thursday in the deadliest Russian attack on the Ukrainian capital this year, prompting a day of mourning on Friday.
In separate overnight attacks on Friday, two more people were killed and eight others injured across different regions of Ukraine.
In the bordering Sumy region, Russian drones hit a private house, resulting in two deaths and one injury, according to Oleh Hryhorov, head of the regional military administration.
In the city of Kryvyi Rih, the hometown of President Volodymyr Zelensky, seven people were injured after a Russian missile strike hit a densely built urban area.
The attacks involved a massive scale of weaponry, with reports indicating the use of hundreds of drones and dozens of missiles over an 11-hour period.
Ukrainian officials continue to report casualties and damage as the country deals with the the aftermath of these coordinated strikes.

headline_marked: Pop star [[Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are married]], reports Page Six
headline: Pop star Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are married, reports Page Six
summary: The couple reportedly exchanged vows in a private ceremony and are preparing for lavish celebrations at New York's Madison Square Garden.
details: Pop music megastar Taylor Swift and NFL player Travis Kelce are married, according to a report by the New York Post's Page Six, citing unnamed sources.
The couple, both 36, reportedly exchanged vows in front of a small group of loved ones in a private ceremony, though the exact location and time were not disclosed.
While neither has commented publicly, preparations are underway for large-scale celebrations at New York's Madison Square Garden (MSG), with events for 100 and 1,000 guests respectively.
To mark the occasion, Swift's publicity team announced that the couple has donated $26 million to various charities in New York City and other locations this week.
Madison Square Garden has been transformed with foliage and high-end catering, while police have set up barriers and closed streets around the venue to manage the crowds.
The union, dubbed 'America's royal wedding,' follows a public courtship and an engagement announcement in August, which has enchanted fans worldwide.
A star-studded guest list is expected, with celebrity friends like Selena Gomez, Ed Sheeran, and Emma Stone likely to attend the celebrations.
